description: Deterministic filter applied to every LLM output (lib/guardrails.ts). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions. Add every miss the evals catch. Categories: relationship verdicts (should end/continue, compatible/incompatible), diagnoses, trait labels applied to a person, statements about a person's worth.
relationship_verdict: \b(you|the two of you|you both|you two|this couple|the couple|they) (are|seems?|appears?( to be)?|looks?|feels?|sounds?)( like| to be| to me like)? (an? )?(incompatible|compatible|(good|bad|poor|great|perfect|terrible|strong|weak) match|mismatched|well[- ]matched|badly matched|(not )?meant for each other|(not )?right for each other|wrong for each other|made for each other)\b
\b(this|the|your) (relationship|marriage) (will|won't|will not|is going to|is likely to|is unlikely to) (last|survive|succeed|fail|end|work out)\b
\b(it's|it is) (time|best|better) to (move on|walk away|call it quits|end (it|things))\b
diagnosis: \b(has|have|had|suffers? from|struggles? with|is|are|shows? signs of|meets? (the )?criteria for|is (clearly|likely|probably) (living with|dealing with))\s+(a\s+|an\s+)?(major depressive|depressive|depression|clinical depression|generalized anxiety|anxiety disorder|panic disorder|bipolar|borderline|narcissistic|antisocial|avoidant personality|dependent personality|obsessive[- ]compulsive disorder|ocd|ptsd|post[- ]traumatic|adhd|attention deficit|autism|autistic|personality disorder|eating disorder|substance (use|abuse) disorder|alcoholism|addiction|dysthymia|adjustment disorder|attachment disorder|sex(ual)? addiction|hypersexual|hypoactive sexual desire disorder)\b
trait_label: \b(you|he|she|they|your partner|partner a|partner b|[a-z]+) (is|are|seems?|appears?|comes across as|sounds?|reads? as|tends? to be|can be) (very |quite |rather |pretty |extremely |a bit |somewhat |kind of |sort of |clearly |obviously |simply )?(rigid|inflexible|avoidant|anxious|insecure|immature|childish|selfish|self-centered|self-absorbed|narcissistic|controlling|manipulative|toxic|abusive|lazy|irresponsible|needy|clingy|cold|distant|emotionally unavailable|emotionally immature|passive[- ]aggressive|codependent|dismissive|neglectful|dramatic|hysterical|unstable|unreliable|untrustworthy|dishonest|a liar|a cheater|a narcissist|a bully|difficult|impossible|broken|damaged|crazy|insane)\b
worth: \b(you|he|she|they|your partner) (deserve|don't deserve|do not deserve|doesn't deserve|does not deserve) (better|worse|this|love|happiness|respect)\b
\b(you|he|she|they) (should be ashamed|are to blame|is to blame|are at fault|is at fault)\b
